notes.title: Announcing the release date!
notes.notes:
Hello!

This is Agnès, founder and solo developer at games studio 2054. 

I've been a bit silent these last couple of months as I've been 100% focused on the last stages of development, which as you may know, are usually the toughest ones. It's been demanding and intense, but things have progressed well and today, I'm pleased to finally announce the release date for The Sundew.

I prepared a new trailer for that. Enjoy:

[previewyoutube=cDs9rqMhc7k;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]The Sundew is launching on October 14th.[/b]

This is very exciting for me and I hope that all of you point-and-click fans enjoy the work I've been making over the last couple of years. I see The Sundew as a love letter to the classic style of adventure games of old, and I put a lot of love into it.

Your flight to Shibukawa, Japan, is set to depart soon...

All the best,

Agnès
